rationale: Under section 6 (Passport and Travel Documents) the passport was destroyed during the covered trip, and the manual's wild-animal note treats a giraffe loss as accidental damage, so the hotel's written statement plus the receipts satisfy the document requirements. The eligible costs are $165 fee + $18 photos + $60 taxis = $243, which is under the $250 Premium passport maximum and has no deductible, so the full $243 is payable.
